milestones.name: Reviewed Mac qualification plan
milestones.bar: A qualification plan for a shipped high-end game: every recovery and presentation claim has an observable proof on the named Mac target, respects C02/C06/C07 ownership and states what its instrumentation cannot establish.

items.statement: Independent review verifies runtime ownership, both Mac game outcomes and the limits of their instrumentation; the build plan links the qualification plan.
items.ask: Do the shared platform design, bounded-frame-host decision and Mac plan preserve one world clock, platform surface/device ownership and FrameHost submission/history ownership? Do the held-drawable recovery and slow-pan proofs distinguish authority, queue calls, GPU completion, display refresh and app-attributed presentation, without claiming unmeasured input-to-photon timing or taking over G3t/G4 or sibling platform work? Is this plan linked from G3b in docs/BUILD-PLAN.md?

milestones.name: The same Mac game resumes after graphics loss
milestones.bar: Recovery fit for a shipped high-end game: the same cooked noon valley, world, window and controls survive graphics loss. The same-build uninterrupted run is the exact paused-image oracle; the proposed Ground E noon view supplies intact composition, and normal-speed motion proves restored interaction.

items.statement: A Metal destroy with a drawable held recovers in the same PID/window without old-queue submit or present calls after destroy. Running authority commits ticks during loss before replacement submission; paused authority retains its tick, epoch, timeline and pause intent. Injected P/E use the normal app key handler, and Resume is acknowledged before arming the running row.
items.ask: Do the arm-disabled, paused-loss and running-loss rows use the same diagnostic binary, parameters and cooked generation? Trace held-drawable acquire/destroy/callback/abandon/replacement and every old-queue call including empty submits in the raw events and audit. Are same PID/window identity, injected P and Resume acknowledgement, ticks 80 and 81 before replacement submit, the paused endpoint and E's shared physical-key handler all established?

items.statement: All 2,073,600 paused pixels match before/after recovery and the same binary's arm-disabled control; independent normal-speed review identifies composited camera response after replacement submit/present in both loss rows.
items.inspect: Review the original arm-disabled, paused-loss and running-loss recordings at 1× beside the proposed Ground E noon reference. Inspect the pre-loss valley, recovery transition and post-replacement E response in both loss rows, using decoded transition frames as well as the complete motion. Confirm intact composition and an actual composited camera shift while the control holds framing; record capture gaps without treating recording PTS as panel cadence.
items.ask: Do the raw readbacks and audit establish equality of all 8,294,400 RGBA bytes across pre-loss, post-loss and arm-disabled paused endpoints, with matching acknowledged state and build identity?

milestones.name: The cooked valley presents smoothly on built-in ProMotion
milestones.bar: Coherent slow camera motion fit for a shipped high-end game in the cooked noon valley, reviewed at 1x from exact submitted engine output. Unattended elapsed-time runtime motion and attended built-in ProMotion cadence are separate required proofs. Record local holds and investigate visible hitches; no numeric performance threshold is a gate.

items.statement: The current release cooked noon valley retains coherent elapsed-time input-driven motion in an unattended real-time offscreen run, including both endpoint holds and the full two-second 0-to-36-degree pan. This qualifies engine runtime motion; it does not establish display-link, compositor or panel behavior. M2 qualifies the current surface path without waiting for APPLE-TILE; Mac M3 owns post-APPLE-TILE-M3 requalification.
items.inspect: Using T2-CAPTURE M0, rerun the documented 1920x1080 pan with a paused world, 120 Hz requested opportunities and normal semantic controls while the console is locked and Screen Recording permission is unavailable. Review full-resolution source images, native-size crops and the host-time-preserving 1x movie using the worded inspection list: rock and ridges retain coherent relative placement; the sphere follows the authored sweep, including its exit from frame; settled endpoints agree with the declared yaw and scene; no cut, snap or reversal. Record repeats, local holds and gross pauses against host time. The Ground E PNG identifies scene and framing only; judge quality against this list and the milestone bar, never by matching a target image or awaiting owner image approval. Record lock state opportunistically without locking an active user or unlocking by automation. Verify actual monotonic timing, complete one-second initial/final holds and full two-second sweep, and join requested, accepted and submitted yaw to image/submission IDs. Capture omissions make the interval inconclusive. Do not substitute a fixed-step route, endpoint redraw or static parity. Preserve the historical 0d53d3aa motion pass and its 38.3/51.7 ms content holds as historical evidence only.

items.statement: ATTENDED SETUP: the current capture-disabled build has independently attributable displayed frame intervals on the active built-in panel for the full pan. An unlocked active display and any OS Instruments authorization are needed; engine content taps require no Screen Recording grant. Without fresh attributable swaps, cadence and the whole milestone remain open. Current-path qualification follows the windowed-tap/tooling proofs M2.3/M2.4, without waiting for APPLE-TILE. Mac M3 owns requalification after APPLE-TILE M3 changes the path.
items.inspect: After M2.3/M2.4, run three matched release/noon/fixed-store arms on the unlocked built-in panel: capture ON/untraced for content, capture ON/Game Performance for observer comparison, and capture OFF/Game Performance for the shipping cadence claim. Keep build, content, recipe, extent and AppKit slider target/action sweep identical, with one-second settled start/end holds and the full two-second pan. Keep normal frame markers in all arms, with no capture targets/copies/readbacks/workers in the OFF arm. Review original host-time-preserving 1x ON sequences and local holds; any swaps from ON are labelled under capture. Require the same build/content as M2.1 or rerun it. In the OFF arm require a readable trace and displayed-surfaces-interval export: unique game window/PID/built-in display, resolved XML references and rotating surfaces into one app-labelled stream. Use numeric Swap Time, not frame-label continuity. Align the full pan using same-process markers or a calibrated monotonic join with correlated anchor and stated error. Record intervals, gaps/unmatched samples, display mode, build/recipe, run order/load and CPU/GPU rows; compare the matched ON/OFF traced arms for capture overhead and ON traced/untraced arms for tracing overhead. Leave cadence open if export, attribution or alignment is ambiguous.
items.ask: Does the evidence distinguish callback target, opportunity, actor acquisition/submit, GPU completion, engine image/sample time, movie PTS, VSync and attributed compositor Swap Time? Is there independent OS attribution for this run/pan rather than the historical 5 November trace? Does attended setup name unlocked-display and any Instruments authorization needs without requiring the owner to play or grant Screen Recording for engine pixels? Engine pixels exclude native widgets/final compositor appearance: are those limits explicit, with any essential additional OS/physical observation separately attended and justified? Are input-to-photon and physical iPhone timing unmeasured, all interval figures observations, and the historical motion pass preserved without extending it to a new build? Is the qualified swap stream from capture OFF, with ON cadence labelled under capture and ordinary direct presentation preserved? Are the untraced/traced content and capture OFF traced roles distinguished?

items.statement: ATTENDED SETUP: the shared T2 tap is integrated and qualified on a real CAMetalLayer window, preserving presented-output correspondence, surface leases and the capture-disabled direct path.
items.ask: Trace T2 renderer-owned tap integration through normal AppKit callbacks and the real CAMetalLayer surface. With a known channel/row pattern, prove capture bytes equal the engine output consumed by the normal present pass, including any declared format/channel conversion. Establish the single producer binding to the actual surface submission; this is not a claim to observe compositor pixels. Prove capture neither reacquires nor extends the drawable lease. Lose/replace the surface with readback pending and show stale-generation refusal plus healthy fresh presentation. With capture OFF prove no tap texture/copy/readback/worker/per-frame allocation or changed present path; retain the current direct-output behavior and Mac M1 loss rules. Run real-Metal regressions with ./dev check under gpu, plus the documented live-window scenario; unavailable/occluded window cannot pass.
items.inspect: On the unlocked active panel inspect the known-pattern window and same-build cooked scene before/after surface replacement, joining engine tap IDs to real surface submissions. Screen Recording permission is not required; label engine versus compositor limits.

items.statement: The Mac qualification builder resolves trace finalization in a bounded investigation and retains a readable fresh Game Performance trace/export on the active built-in panel.
items.ask: After this re-plan passes independent design review and T2-CAPTURE M0 is done, without waiting for APPLE-TILE, the Mac M2 builder owns the resumed investigation. Inspect retained failed bundles/logs first and write a changed, falsifiable hypothesis before recording. With unlocked active display and existing Instruments authorization, allow at most two new diagnostic record attempts total under the 9 November tooling commission, each 16 seconds plus at most 75 seconds finalization. This dependency re-plan and the Mac M3 split do not renew that allowance. Then export TOC and displayed-surfaces-interval with finite recorded timeouts. Stop only owned tool/game processes at the deadline; never retry an unchanged failed hypothesis or kill unrelated processes. A successful probe must export actual app/window-attributed swaps and leave a reusable documented command. If no justified hypothesis exists, authorization is unavailable, or the attempt budget exhausts, record the cause and M2.2/M2.4 blocked in status/build-plan; keep both open and continue unrelated work. No success from a trace directory existing, historical swaps or a substitute capture timestamp.

milestones.name: The post-G3t Mac surface path requalifies runtime motion and built-in cadence
milestones.bar: Coherent slow camera motion fit for a shipped high-end game in the cooked noon valley, reviewed at 1x from exact submitted engine output. Unattended elapsed-time runtime motion and attended built-in ProMotion cadence are separate required proofs. Record local holds and investigate visible hitches; no numeric performance threshold is a gate.

items.statement: After APPLE-TILE M3 lands, fresh elapsed-time engine motion qualifies its integrated surface/present path using the full Mac M2.1 protocol; pre-G3t evidence remains valid only for its earlier build.
items.inspect: Rerun the implemented M2.1 command on the post-APPLE-TILE-M3 release assembly: locked-console 1920x1080 paused-world noon pan, 120 Hz requested opportunities, normal semantic input, one-second holds and full two-second 0-to-36-degree sweep. Apply every M2.1 timing, coverage, provenance and worded visual criterion to fresh full-resolution frames, native-size crops and host-time-preserving 1x motion. A pre-change run or fixed-step movie cannot pass.
items.ask: Join source/build/shader/content/recipe identity to the integrated APPLE-TILE M3 path. Are the complete M2.1 proof and observer limits retained, with no reuse of an earlier verdict for changed output?

items.statement: ATTENDED SETUP: after APPLE-TILE M3 lands, fresh built-in-panel cadence and matched capture observer arms qualify the changed path under the full Mac M2.2 protocol, with the windowed tap and trace tooling revalidated on that build.
items.inspect: On the unlocked active built-in panel with Instruments authorization, rerun all three M2.2 arms on the same post-G3t build/content/recipe/extent as M3.1: ON untraced, ON traced and OFF traced. Require the complete pan and holds, normal AppKit controls, fresh readable app/window-attributed numeric Swap Time and a calibrated join with stated error. Review full-resolution ON sequences at 1x; cadence comes only from OFF. Apply every M2.2 attribution, completeness, overhead and clock-separation criterion. No earlier trace or functional-window-only run can pass.
items.ask: Revalidate the M2.3 known-pattern correspondence, lease, pending-readback loss and capture-OFF direct-path proofs on the changed graph/present path. Rerun the M2.4 qualified trace/export command; no new diagnostic-attempt allowance is granted by M3. If trace tooling regresses, record it blocked and require a scoped re-plan before further diagnostic attempts. Does fresh M3.1 motion match this build, and are both post-change items independently reviewed before claiming final Mac qualification for V1?
